description: This source file provides platform-specific portability functions, including thread ID retrieval, sleep functions, call stack dumping, and byte order conversions, with conditional compilation for Linux, Windows, and Apple platforms.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from string to network address structure, with Unicode support.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for specified microseconds on Windows.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub for mremap function on Apple platforms.

methods.name: gettid
methods.description: Retrieves thread ID on Apple platforms.

methods.name: GetPCFromUContext
methods.description: Extracts program counter from ucontext_t structure for backtrace.

methods.name: OverrideStackTopWithPC
methods.description: Replaces top of stack with program counter for backtrace.

methods.name: CallstackSignalHandler
methods.description: Handles signal to capture call stack.

methods.name: GetCallStack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack addresses for a thread, with cross-platform support.

methods.name: DumpCallStack
methods.description: Dumps call stack information into a list, with symbol resolution.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for specified milliseconds on Linux.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleeps for specified microseconds on Linux and Windows.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts 64-bit integer from host to network byte order.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts 64-bit integer from network to host byte order.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Demangles C++ symbol names on Linux and processes names on Windows.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts class name without template parameters or namespace.
